thread:
leah: Auditor asked for a packaged evidence bundle for the 2026-03-10 incident — they want RBAC change diffs, KMS key access logs, and any forensic artifacts (screenshots, runbook playback). Do we have a manifest or a standard checklist?

samir: tagging @oz — can you pull KMS access logs and CloudTrail entries? auditor wants caller identity and key ops.

oz: Yep. I can export CloudTrail for the window and filter kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt. Which time range?

leah: Primary window 2026-03-10T02:15:00Z -> 2026-03-10T03:00:00Z, but include 24h around the incident for context. Auditor asked for evidence hashes, not raw PII.

maya: For RBAC we should include: k8s rolebinding and clusterrolebinding diffs, terraform state snapshot (commit abc123def), and the GitHub PR that applied the change. Also a note of who approved.

samir: Quick question — do auditors want raw logs or redacted copies with a hashproof? they mentioned 'sanitized with integrity proof'.

leah: They prefer sanitized copies plus a SHA256 manifest and preservation of original hashes for chain-of-custody. Put both the sanitized file and the hash of the original in the manifest.

oz: Plan: export -> kms-access-20260310.csv, cloudtrail-20260310.json.gz, generate sha256_manifest.txt. I'll upload to a restricted S3 bucket and hand out presigned links.

jordan: We also have the oncall runbook recording and the incident chat transcript. Auditor asked for attachments showing timeline — ok to include zoom recording?

leah: Yes, include the runbook playback and oncall notes, but redact internal emails and any PII. Add a short README describing redaction method.

evidence-bot: Reminder: evidence uploads must include metadata: origin, generator, original-hash, sanitizer-id, retention-label. See /docs/compliance/evidence-upload.md for required fields.

maya: For the RBAC diff I ran: `kubectl get rolebinding -n prod -o yaml > rolebinding-20260309.yaml` and compared to `rolebinding-20260310.yaml`. I can drop the diffs into the pack.

samir: I validated the diff and added a comment about the service account principal change. Diffs will be at s3://redwood-compliance/pack-8123456789/diffs/rolebinding-diff.txt

oz: ETA: CloudTrail + KMS exports + manifest by EOD UTC. I'll include the query I used for transparency:```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-09T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-11T00:00:00Z```

leah: Perfect. Once uploads are ready, post presigned links here and I'll share with the auditor during the check-in at 2026-03-10T15:40:00Z. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — I'll prep the redaction README and note what was removed.

leah: One last ask from auditor: include a short control mapping doc that ties each artifact to SOC2 control IDs (CC6, CC7) and the evidence point. Can someone draft that?

maya: I can draft the control map (will include file paths + sha256 entries).

leah: Awesome. Filing this as the official pack for the check-in. Will post links when all artifacts are uploaded.
